event_name: Time 17:49 70TH ANNIVERSARY GRAND PRIX 6 – 9 August 2020 Renault DP World F1 Team lodged protests against Cars 18 and 27 of BWT Racing Point F1 Team. The protests were lodged in a timely manner. Following the publication of Stewards Decision Document 41, Renault DP World F1 Team has subsequently withdrawn the protests and the Stewards ordered their protest fee returned.
title: Disposition Of Protest
